outcome: gene expression in lipid metabolism pathways
cohort: Placentas from mothers of different self-identified races, with different fetal sexes, experiencing either spontaneous early preterm birth or term birth.
finding: The study found significant race and fetal sex differences in lipid metabolism and inflammation within SPTB placentas, with greater dysfunction and inflammation observed in Black compared to White SPTB placentas.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery had no effect on the observed differences in placental lipid metabolism and inflammation.
cross-section timing: At birth (analysis of placentas from SPTB and Term deliveries)
